title: Cardiometabolic trait effector gene predictions (Gloudemans et al., 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Integration of genetic colocalizations with physiological and pharmacological perturbations identifies cardiometabolic disease genes.
Gloudemans MJ, Balliu B, et al.
Genome Med. 2022 Mar 15;14(1):31. doi: 10.1186/s13073-022-01036-8.
PMID: 35292083

The list below displays candidate causal genes for cardiometabolic traits, determined by integration of genetic association results, expression and splicing quantitative trait loci (eQTLs and sQTLs), transcriptional regulation by physiological and pharmacological cardiometabolic regulators, and protein-protein interaction networks. Click the Research Method tab for more details.
